title: Nexus AI SDLC Pipeline Stage Contract
description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for a single Nexus AI pipeline stage contract. Field set is the Pipeline Stage Contract from docs/ai-sdlc-factory/07-pipeline-contract-standard.md section 4 (mirrored in configs/nexus-ai/pipeline_contract_standard.yaml stage_required_fields), PLUS applicability_decision (conditional stages only), conditional_required_gates, and max_iterations. Locked decisions enforced: no 'plugin' concept anywhere; owner_agent is a snake_case pipeline Agent ROLE string and may never be a Core Ability; all 7 usage-mapping arrays are required (each may be empty []).

coreAbilityName.description: The 8 canonical Core Abilities. Core Abilities are NOT agents and NOT team members; they may never appear as owner_agent or as an Agent role.

agentRole.description: A pipeline Agent ROLE: snake_case identifier. Must NOT be one of the 8 Core Abilities (neither the canonical PascalCase form nor a lowercased form).

routingTarget.description: A routing destination: either a known stage_id (snake_case) or a canonical terminal (done, relevant_failed_stage, block_and_report).

usageArray.description: A Shared Registry + Usage Mapping array. Required to be present even when empty ([]).

conditionalRequiredGate.description: A gate that is required only under a condition. Canonical artifacts use three shapes: (a) a bare gate-id string; (b) an object keyed by 'gate_id' with required_when; (c) an object keyed by 'gate' with required_when plus optional severity/attested_by. All three are accepted. Object forms must carry required_when and identify the gate via 'gate' or 'gate_id'. No 'plugin' key is permitted.

applicabilityDecision.description: Applicability decision for a CONDITIONAL stage. The only field guaranteed across all canonical stage variants is required_when; other keys (decision/decision_artifact, produced_by, evaluated_from, on_not_applicable/when_not_applicable, record_evidence, route, etc.) vary by stage and are permitted. No 'plugin' key is allowed at any depth handled here.

owner_team.description: Owning team. Canonically sdlc_team for the SDLC pipeline.

team_lead.description: Team lead role. Canonically sdlc_team_lead. Supervisor (a Core Ability) is NOT the team lead.

owner_agent.description: The single pipeline Agent ROLE that owns this stage. Always a snake_case agent role; NEVER a Core Ability.

sub_agents.description: Sub-agent roles activated within this stage (snake_case). May be empty.

uses_core_abilities.description: Core Abilities used by this stage. Items should be from the 8 canonical Core Abilities. Required even if empty.

evidence.description: Evidence artifacts produced by this stage. Distinct from trace.

trace.description: Trace items recorded by this stage. Distinct from evidence.

conditional_required_gates.description: Gates required only under a condition. Array (possibly empty); each item is a bare gate-id string or an object with required_when plus a gate identifier ('gate' or 'gate_id'). See $defs/conditionalRequiredGate.

max_iterations.description: Maximum rework iterations for this stage. Default 3.
